rules.rationale: Base equation defining the net bracket-balance delta of the empty IntSeq as zero.
Structural recurrence defining bracketDelta on iCons by adding +1 for code 60 and -1 otherwise, then recursing on the tail.
Base equation defining prefix safety of an empty suffix as true for any starting balance.
Structural recurrence defining bracketPrefixOK by updating the balance, checking its nonnegativity, and recursing on the remaining codes.
Base equation defining the empty IntSeq as belonging to the bracket-character input domain.
Structural recurrence defining bracketChars as membership of every code in the set containing 60 and 62.
Compositional equation defining bracketCorrect as prefix safety from balance zero together with zero final delta.
